name: Rust
description: Installs the Rust toolchain through rustup, with rustc and cargo, on a selectable channel or release line.

version.description: Channel (latest|beta|nightly), a minor line (major.minor), or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.

rustupVersion.description: rustup channel (latest) or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

hosts.name: index.crates.io
hosts.description: Crate index cargo resolves dependencies from

env.name: CARGO_HOME
env.description: Cargo's registry cache and installed tools in the state dir

env.name: RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL
env.description: With 0, toolchains a project asks for install on explicit request
